items.source: Creates a new DataCenterReplication given dataCenter and replicationFactor.
items.translation: 根据 `dataCenter` 和 `replicationFactor` 创建一个新的 DataCenterReplication。

items.source: Returns a map of Options suitable as the value of a KeyspaceOption.REPLICATION option with replication strategy class "NetworkTopologyStrategy" and with data centers each with their corresponding replication factors.
items.translation: 返回一个 `Option` 映射，该映射适用于作为 KeyspaceOption.REPLICATION 选项的值，其复制策略类为 "NetworkTopologyStrategy"，且每个数据中心都包含其对应的复制因子。

items.source: Keyspace object action specifications such as CREATE TABLE, DROP INDEX.
items.translation: 键空间对象操作规范，例如CREATE TABLE、DROP INDEX。

items.source: Configure datacenter replication given DataCenterReplication.
items.translation: 根据DataCenterReplication配置数据中心复制。

items.source: Uses of DataCenterReplication in org.springframework.data.cassandra.core.cql.keyspace
items.translation: org.springframework.data.cassandra.core.cql.keyspace 包中 DataCenterReplication 的用法
